strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Manhajar Sayarwa daga Mota da Wakilan Sayarwa
strings.tierB.home.description: Manhaja ga masu rarraba kaya: takardar sayarwa da rasit daga waya, kayan mota, karɓar kuɗi, hanyoyi da ziyara. Tana aiki babu intanet, sannan ta daidaita.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Ku jagoranci wakilan sayarwarku daga ziyarar farko har zuwa karɓar kuɗi na ƙarshe
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales dandali ne na girgije (cloud) ga kamfanonin rarraba kaya da 'yan sari waɗanda ke da wakilan sayarwa masu zagaye, ciki har da sayarwa daga mota (van sales). Wakilai suna fitar da takardun sayarwa da rasit kuma suna buga su daga wayarsu, suna bin diddigin kayan da ke cikin motarsu kuma suna rubuta ziyarori, yayin da manajoji ke ganin abin da aka sayar, kuɗin da aka karɓa da bashin abokan ciniki a lokacin da abin ke faruwa.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Takardar sayarwa daga wayar wakili
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Wakili yana fitar da takardar sayarwa a ƙofar shagon abokin ciniki kuma ya buga ta da firintar Bluetooth mai zafi (thermal) kafin ya bar shagon.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Karɓar kuɗi da bashin abokan ciniki
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Kowane biya yana samun rasit mai lamba da ke haɗe da takardun sayarwa da ya biya, kuma ragowar bashin abokin ciniki da bayanin asusunsa suna sabuntawa nan take.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Amanar kayan mota
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Ana bin kayan kowace mota kaya-kaya: abin da aka ɗora, aka sayar, aka dawo da shi da abin da ya rage, don haka giɓi yana bayyana a ranar kanta.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Hanyoyi da ziyarori
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Ana rubuta ziyarori tare da wuri, lokaci da hotuna, kuma ana zana hanyar kowane wakili a taswira ga manaja.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Yana aiki babu intanet
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Wakilai suna ci gaba da sayarwa ko babu network. Takardu suna jira a waya kuma suna daidaita kansu, ba tare da maimaitawa ba, idan sadarwa ta dawo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Dashboard na yanar gizo ga manajoji
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Sayarwa, karɓar kuɗi, kayan da aka dawo, kaya da ƙwazon wakilai a wuri ɗaya, tare da matsayi da izini ga kowane mai amfani.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Faɗa mana yadda kuke sayarwa
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Ku nemi ƙiyasin farashi ko ku shirya ganawa. Za mu duba wakilanku, hanyoyinku, kayayyakinku da buƙatunku na takardar sayarwa.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Ku shirya kamfaninku
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Ku shigar da kayayyaki, farashi, abokan ciniki da wakilai, sannan ku saita kuɗin ƙasarku da adadin harajinku a cikin saitunan.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Ku tura wakilai zuwa fage
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Wakilai suna zazzage manhajar a Android ko iPhone, su ɗora kaya a motarsu, sannan su fara sayarwa, bugawa da karɓar kuɗi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Ku bi ranar yayin da take gudana
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Dashboard na yanar gizo yana nuna sayarwa, karɓar kuɗi, kayan mota da ziyarori yayin da wakilai ke kan hanya.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales dandali ne na girgije don gudanar da wakilan sayarwa masu zagaye a kamfanonin rarraba kaya da na sari. Ya ƙunshi sayarwa daga mota (van sales), sayarwa ta bin hanya (route sales), karɓar oda kafin kawowa (pre-sales) da kai kaya kai tsaye zuwa shago (DSD). Wakilai suna fitar da takardar sayarwa, bugawa, karɓar kuɗi da rubuta ziyara daga wayarsu, kuma manajoji suna bin sayarwa, karɓar kuɗi, kayan mota da bashin abokan ciniki daga dashboard na yanar gizo.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: Shin FieldSales yana aiki ba tare da intanet ba?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: I. Manhajar wakili tana ci gaba da aiki babu intanet: wakilai suna fitar da takardun sayarwa da rasit kuma suna buga su, suna rubuta ziyarori kuma suna ƙara sababbin abokan ciniki, kuma komai yana daidaita kansa ba tare da maimaitawa ba idan sadarwa ta dawo. Akwai keɓancewa ɗaya a Saudiyya: kamfanonin da suka kunna haɗin takardar sayarwa ta lantarki suna buƙatar sadarwa a lokacin fitar da takardar sayarwa ko ta dawowar kaya.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.q: Waɗanne ƙasashe FieldSales yake yi wa hidima?
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales yana yi wa kamfanonin rarraba kaya hidima a kowace ƙasa, ciki har da Najeriya, Nijar da Ghana. Kowane kamfani yana saita kuɗin ƙasarsa da adadin harajinsa a cikin saitunansa, kuma takardun sayarwa, rasit da rahotanni suna amfani da su. Hedikwatar FieldSales tana Riyadh, Saudiyya, kuma ana fara aiki ta yanar gizo ta hanyar ganawa, WhatsApp da tallafi daga nesa.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Shin FieldSales yana haɗuwa da tsarin gwamnati na takardar sayarwa ta lantarki?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Muna goyon bayan haɗin Mataki na Biyu da dandalin Fatoora na ZATCA. Wannan ya shafi kamfanoni a Saudiyya. A sauran ƙasashe, ciki har da Najeriya, Nijar da Ghana, FieldSales yana fitar da takardun sayarwa da kuɗin ƙasarku da adadin harajinku, kuma haɗawa da tsarin ƙasa na takardar sayarwa ta lantarki ana samu idan an nema, bayan mun duba buƙatun ƙasar tare da ku. Ba mu yi alƙawarin dacewa da kowane tsarin ƙasa a wajen Saudiyya ba.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: A waɗanne harsuna ake samun manhajar FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Ana samun fuskar manhajar FieldSales (interface) a harsunan Larabci, Turanci, Faransanci, Turkanci da Sinanci kawai. Babu fuskar manhaja da Hausa, amma Turanci da Faransanci suna cikinsu. Wakilai da manajoji za su iya canza harshen fuskar manhajar, kuma takardar sayarwa da aka buga za ta iya ɗaukar harshe na biyu kusa da babban harshen. Shafukan yanar gizo a wasu harsuna, kamar wannan shafin Hausa, fassara ne don ba da bayani game da manhajar.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: Ta yaya zan fara amfani da FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Ku nemi ƙiyasin farashi, ku shirya ganawa ko ku aiko mana da saƙo ta WhatsApp. Za mu fahimci yadda wakilanku ke aiki, sannan mu taimaka muku shirya kayayyaki, farashi, abokan ciniki da wakilai. Wakilai suna zazzage manhajar a Android ko iPhone, manajoji kuma suna amfani da dashboard na yanar gizo daga kowane burauza. Wayoyin hannu na zamani (smartphone) ne kaɗai na'urorin da kuke buƙata.
strings.tierB.home.cta.whatsapp: Yi magana da mu ta WhatsApp
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Ana samun fuskar manhajar FieldSales a harsunan Larabci, Turanci, Faransanci, Turkanci da Sinanci; babu Hausa a cikinsu. Shafuka a wasu harsuna suna bayyana manhajar don bayani kawai.
strings.tierB.category.title: Manhajar Sayarwa daga Mota (Van Sales) | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Manhajar sayarwa daga mota da ta bin hanya: takardar sayarwa da ake bugawa daga waya, kayan mota kaya-kaya, karɓar kuɗi da ziyara. Tana aiki babu intanet.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Manhajar sayarwa daga mota ga masu rarraba kaya da 'yan sari
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales manhajar sayarwa daga mota ce (van sales) ga kamfanonin da wakilansu ke sayarwa daga mota a kan hanyoyi na yau da kullum. Wakili yana ɗora kaya a mota, yana sayarwa a kowane shago, yana buga takardar sayarwa, yana karɓar kuɗi kuma yana rubuta kayan da aka dawo da su, duk daga manhaja ɗaya a wayarsa. Manaja yana ganin abin da aka ɗora, aka sayar, aka karɓa da abin da ya rage a kowace mota.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Mece ce manhajar sayarwa daga mota?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Manhajar sayarwa daga mota, wadda ake kira cash van ko route sales, tana gudanar da tsarin sayarwa inda wakili yake ɗauke da kaya a mota kuma ya sayar, ya kai, ya fitar da takardar sayarwa kuma ya karɓi kuɗi a ziyara ɗaya. Tana maye gurbin littattafan takardar sayarwa na hannu da kiran waya na ƙarshen yini. Tana rubuta kowace sayarwa, biya da dawowar kaya a matsayin takarda, don a iya kwatanta kaya da kuɗi a rana ɗaya. Ga manaja, tana amsa tambayoyi uku kowace yamma: me kowane wakili ya sayar, nawa ya karɓa, kuma me ya rage a kowace mota.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Yini ɗaya a fage
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Yini yana farawa da ɗora kaya daga ma'ajiya zuwa mota tare da takarda. A kowane shago wakili yana buɗe shafin abokin ciniki, yana ƙara kaya daga jeri ko da barcode, yana fitar da takardar sayarwa kuma yana buga ta da firinta mai zafi (thermal). Ana rubuta biya da rasit, kuma ana rubuta kowace dawowar kaya tare da dalilinta. A ƙarshen yini, abin da ya rage a mota ana sauke shi zuwa ma'ajiya. Tsakanin waɗannan matakai, manaja zai iya bin sayarwa, karɓar kuɗi da ziyarorin kowane wakili daga dashboard na yanar gizo ba tare da ya kira kowa ba.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: An gina shi don raunin network
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Hanyoyin rarraba kaya suna ratsa ɗakunan ƙarƙashin ƙasa, yankunan masana'antu da ƙauyuka masu raunin network. Manhajar wakili ta FieldSales tana adana abokan ciniki, kayayyaki da farashi a waya, don wakili ya iya fitar da takardu kuma ya buga su ba tare da intanet ba. Kowace takarda tana da maɓalli na musamman, don haka tana shiga sabar sau ɗaya kawai, ko da an sake ƙoƙarin aikawa. Kamfanonin Saudiyya da suka kunna haɗin takardar sayarwa ta lantarki suna buƙatar sadarwa a lokacin fitar da takardun sayarwa da na dawowar kaya. A gare su ma, rasit, ziyarori da sababbin abokan ciniki suna aiki babu intanet.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Karɓar kuɗi da amanar mota
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Kuɗin da ke kan hanya yana buƙatar kulawa kamar kaya. Kowane karɓar kuɗi yana samun rasit mai lamba wanda za a iya haɗa shi da takardun sayarwa da ya biya, kuma ragowar bashin abokin ciniki tana sabuntawa nan take. Ana lissafin kayan mota kaya-kaya: abin da aka ɗora a cire abin da aka sayar, a ƙara kayan da aka dawo da gyare-gyaren da aka rubuta, don manajoji su iya kwatanta shi da ƙidaya ta zahiri kafin wakili ya tafi gida. Ana iya rarraba kayan da aka dawo a matsayin na yau da kullum, lalatattu ko na musanya, kuma manaja ne ke yanke shawarar ko za su koma cikin kayan motar da ake iya sayarwa.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Ga waɗanda ya dace da su
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales ya dace da masu rarraba kaya da 'yan sari na kayayyakin masarufi masu saurin sayuwa kamar abinci, abubuwan sha, kayan tsafta da kayan kula da jiki, da duk wani kamfani da ke da wakilai masu ziyartar shaguna a kan hanyoyi. Yana tallafawa sayarwa daga mota, karɓar oda kafin kawowa da kai kaya kai tsaye zuwa shago. Ba cikakken ERP ba ne: yana haɗuwa da tsarin lissafin kuɗinku ko ERP ta hanyar API. Manajoji ne ke iko da abin da kowane wakili zai iya yi, kamar ba da ragi, sayarwa ƙasa da farashin jeri ko ƙara sababbin abokan ciniki.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Mene ne bambanci tsakanin sayarwa daga mota da karɓar oda kafin kawowa?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: A sayarwa daga mota, wakili yana ɗauke da kaya kuma yana kai su, ya fitar da takardar sayarwa kuma ya karɓi kuɗi a ziyara guda. A karɓar oda kafin kawowa (pre-sales), wakili yana karɓar oda wadda ma'ajiya za ta kai daga baya. FieldSales yana tallafawa duka biyun, don haka kamfani zai iya amfani da cash van a wasu hanyoyi da karɓar oda a wasu. A cikin tsarin biyun, takardun sayarwa, karɓar kuɗi da bashin abokan ciniki suna cikin tsari ɗaya, kuma manajoji suna ganinsu a rahotanni iri ɗaya.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Ta yaya zan daidaita lissafin mota a ƙarshen yini?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales yana nuna, ga kowane kaya a kowace mota, adadin da aka ɗora, aka sayar, aka dawo da shi da wanda ya rage. Ku kwatanta adadin da ya rage da ƙidaya ta zahiri, ku rubuta duk wani bambanci a matsayin gyara mai takarda, sannan ku sauke sauran zuwa ma'ajiya da motsi ɗaya. Mota tana fara gobe da lissafi mai tsabta da aka sani.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Wace na'ura ce wakilin sayarwa daga mota yake buƙata?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Waya ta zamani (smartphone), Android ko iPhone. Firintar Bluetooth mai zafi (thermal) zaɓi ce, kuma tana ba wakili damar ba wa abokin ciniki takardar sayarwa ko rasit da aka buga. FieldSales ba ya sayar da na'urori kuma ba ya tilasta wani takamaiman nau'in firinta. Manajoji suna amfani da dashboard na yanar gizo daga burauzar kowace kwamfuta ko waya.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Shin FieldSales zai iya haɗuwa da tsarin lissafin kuɗinmu?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: I. FieldSales yana da API wanda ke ba tsarin lissafin kuɗinku ko ERP damar musayar abokan ciniki, kayayyaki, takardun sayarwa, rasit da motsin kaya da dandalin. Ƙungiyarku ko mai haɗa tsarinku ne ke gina haɗin ta amfani da takardun bayanin API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales a Ƙasashe: Kuɗi, Haraji da Takardar Lantarki
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales yana aiki ga masu rarraba kaya a kowace ƙasa. Ku ga kuɗi, harajin sayarwa da matsayin takardar sayarwa ta lantarki na kowace ƙasa a tebur ɗaya.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales yana yi wa kamfanonin rarraba kaya hidima a kowace ƙasa. Kowane kamfani yana zaɓar ƙasarsa, kuɗinsa da adadin harajinsa a cikin saitunansa, kuma takardun sayarwa, rasit da rahotanni suna bin su. Haɗin gwamnati na takardar sayarwa ta lantarki yana aiki a Saudiyya kaɗai. A kowace ƙasa banda ita, ana samu idan an nema. Teburin da ke ƙasa yana nuna, ga kowace ƙasa, kuɗin ƙasar, adadin harajin sayarwa ko VAT da aka saba, da ko haɗin gwamnati na takardar sayarwa ta lantarki yana aiki ko ana samu idan an nema.
strings.tierB.countries.columns.einvoicing: Takardar sayarwa ta lantarki ta gwamnati
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Muna goyon bayan haɗin Mataki na Biyu da dandalin Fatoora na ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Kowane kamfani ne ke saita kuɗi da adadin haraji a cikin saitunansa. Adadin da ke wannan tebur jagora ne na gaba ɗaya kuma zai iya canzawa; ku duba dokokin yanzu tare da mai ba ku shawara kan haraji. Alamar ɗan layi (—) tana nufin babu adadi na gaba ɗaya da aka jera ga wannan ƙasa.
strings.tierB.about.title: Game da FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales yana gina manhajar girgije ga kamfanonin rarraba kaya masu wakilan sayarwa. An kafa shi a 2026 a Riyadh, Saudiyya.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (sunansa da Larabci فيلد سيلز) dandali ne na girgije ga kamfanonin rarraba kaya da na sari waɗanda ke da wakilan sayarwa masu zagaye. An kafa kamfanin a 2026 kuma hedikwatarsa tana Riyadh, Saudiyya. Yana yi wa kamfanoni hidima a kowace ƙasa, kuma kowane kamfani yana saita kuɗin ƙasarsa da adadin harajinta a cikin saitunansa. Abokan cinikinmu kamfanoni ne da ke sayarwa da kai kaya ta hannun wakilai a kan hanya: masu rarraba kaya, 'yan sari da masana'antun da ke da nasu motocin sayarwa.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Muna gina tsari ɗaya da ya haɗa dukkan zagayen aikin fage: takardun sayarwa da ake bugawa daga wayar wakili, rasit da bashin abokan ciniki, amanar kayan mota, hanyoyi da ziyarori tare da wuri da hotuna, da dashboard na yanar gizo ga manajoji. Manhajar wakili tana aiki a Android da iPhone kuma tana ci gaba da aiki babu intanet, sannan ta daidaita idan sadarwa ta dawo. Kamfanoni za su iya haɗa FieldSales da tsarin lissafin kuɗinsu ko ERP ta hanyar API, don kada a rubuta bayanan fage sau biyu.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Muna bayyana manhajar yadda take. Muna goyon bayan haɗin Mataki na Biyu da dandalin Fatoora na ZATCA. Haɗawa da tsarin gwamnati a wasu ƙasashe ana samu idan an nema. Ana samun fuskar manhajar a harsunan Larabci, Turanci, Faransanci, Turkanci da Sinanci; babu Hausa a cikinsu. Don yin magana da mu, ku nemi ƙiyasin farashi, ku shirya ganawa ko ku aiko mana da saƙo ta WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Tuntuɓi FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Ku yi magana da ƙungiyar FieldSales: ku nemi ƙiyasin farashi, ku shirya ganawa ko ku yi hira ta WhatsApp game da manhajar wakilai da sayarwa daga mota.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Faɗa mana yadda wakilanku ke sayarwa a yau da abin da kuke son canzawa. Ku nemi ƙiyasin farashi, ku shirya ganawa ko ku aiko da saƙo ta WhatsApp, kuma wani daga ƙungiyarmu zai amsa muku. Abokan cinikinmu na yanzu za su iya amfani da waɗannan hanyoyi don neman tallafi. Zai taimaka idan kuka ambaci ƙasarku, yawan wakilanku, da ko suna sayarwa daga mota, suna karɓar oda, ko duka biyun.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Ku shirya ganawa ta yanar gizo da ƙungiyarmu. Za mu nuna muku yinin wakili a cikin manhajar da kuma dashboard na manaja, da misalai masu kama da kayayyakinku da hanyoyinku, kuma mu amsa tambayoyinku game da shirya aiki.
